x: Of the younger generation, Freddie Ocrah sprinted to some fast times for a 'Boy', equalling the club record over 200m, while Richard Blick showed middle distance promise.

In the younger age groups, there were good performances from Richard Blick (800/1500) Joe Minetti (100) and Freddie Ocrah (100/200 Boys). The highlight of the day was the re-enactment of an 100 yards race from the turn of the Century.
And to follow in the footsteps of these, a young man showing much promise is Freddie Ocrah who ran a club best (manual timing) for a 'Boy' with 11.7.
